notes.title: Dev Diary #5
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! 

We hope you had some nice holidays! We are back full of energy and ready to share what we’ve been making these past few weeks.

[list]
[*] Cheshire has been with us from the beginning, but now he has got a beautiful new sprite, shader, and animations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/19f90b8a51774c3038c1ae5a536032a355e9d469.gif[/img]

[*] A while back we asked you all on [url=https://twitter.com/Team_Lunarians]X[/url] which dialogue bubbles you liked the most, so we’ve taken the result and this is how it turned out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/50e906f15680b08e3c12de00093fb3cf162dbbc8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/106a29ba70bc5824f5b0e325da365dd325fb9a49.gif[/img]

[*] Here is a sneak peek of Alice’s third eye ability, which will reveal secrets across the map. Use it if something looks suspicious!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/65db64942d9c4dc16782cd2b85720e8c05e84d9e.gif[/img]

[/list]

Be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Team_Lunarians]X[/url] and wishlist the game on Steam if you haven’t! It helps us a lot!
See you in the next Dev Diary!
